Asobi 1.0 (build 1344) Oct 6, 2026

  • Joining a review: when you watch the host's streamed copies, frame numbers and timecode now match the host's, so a clip that starts at 1001 reads 1001 here too, in the viewer, grabs, exports and the notes report.
Earlier updates

1.0 (build 1340) Oct 5, 2026

  • Real frame numbers for movies: a movie now reads the numbers it was rendered with: a number written in the file, the image sequence rendered beside it (a Nuke movie and its EXRs), or a frame range in its name such as shot_1001-1100.mov. Movies exported from Asobi write their number into the file.
  • Asked once: a movie with a timecode or a render tool's tag but no frame numbers asks for its first frame at the top of the viewer: type it, count it from the timecode, or keep 1. One answer can cover every movie like it, and Asobi remembers it for the file. Playback ▸ First Frame Number… changes it.
  • The same numbers everywhere: the review page, frame grabs and the notes report show them too. Click the timecode on the review page to switch to frame numbers. Footage with no numbering starts at 1.
  • Notes report: timecode reads from the source's own start timecode.
  • Playlist: the line joining a pair switches its compare off (it dims and stays off when you come back to the clip) and on again.

1.0 (build 1311) Oct 4, 2026

  • Fixed: when someone in the review ended a compare from the review page, Asobi kept the second version loaded and the pair showing. Ending it now clears the compare, as Clear Compare does.
  • Playlist: click the line joining a pair to clear its compare. The pair stays.

1.0 (build 1286) Oct 4, 2026

  • Fixed: undoing a mark on the Mac didn't reach the people reviewing with you, and the review page kept showing the mark. Now it goes for everyone.

1.0 (build 1278) Oct 4, 2026

  • See which comments came from a phone or tablet. Notes and replies written in the Asobi app on iPhone or iPad, or on the review page in a mobile browser, show a small device icon beside the author.
  • Fixed: with the notes open, the control bar could run over the notes panel. It now stays beside the picture, and in a small window Open, Save and Zoom move to the menus to make room.

1.0 (build 1271) Oct 4, 2026

  • The control bar always fits its window. In a narrower window, Speed, Rate, Loop, Repeat, In/Out, Cache and the grade switch move into one More menu, and in the narrowest the words under the icons give way (each icon still says what it is when you point at it). Nothing is ever cut off.
  • The colour chip is a fixed size with short names (ACEScg → 709, LogC3 → P3…), so the bar doesn't jump or leave a gap. The full pipeline is in its tooltip and panel.
  • Fixed: making the window smaller moved the control bar for good. It now comes back to where you put it.

1.0 (build 1264) Oct 3, 2026

  • Fixed: people following your review could land one frame ahead of you. When you paused partway through a frame, Asobi showed that frame but told everyone following (the web page, the iPad and iPhone app, other Macs) the next one. Everyone now stops on the frame you see.
  • Small fixes and improvements.

1.0 (build 1259) Oct 3, 2026

  • Showcases in HEVC: each showcase now also carries an HEVC copy — the same picture in about two thirds of the data, so it streams more smoothly (4K most of all). Browsers and the iPad and iPhone app that play HEVC get it; the rest get H.264 as before.
  • Knowing when H.264 can go: every visit to a showcase records whether the viewer could play HEVC, and the Review Manager counts them, for each showcase and across them all.
  • Small fixes and improvements.
